description: Nets International Communication Limited (NETS) is a Pakistani ICT and telecommunications solutions provider, listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange in 2025. The business started in 1983 as National Engineers, a technology-solutions company, and today delivers access networks, enterprise data networks, cybersecurity, cloud and automation, managed services, resource outsourcing and extra-low-voltage systems. Its customers are telecom operators, banks and insurers, public-sector entities, universities and hospitals, served from offices in Lahore, Islamabad, Karachi and overseas.
headOffice: Office No. 3, Level 8, Arfa Software Technology Park, Ferozepur Road, Lahore, Pakistan
